'''Dajjun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] actively during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served the Order and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the conflict.

==History==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Dajjun eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] after years of study and field work as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Taking [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Karii]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Dajjun heeded the call of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; Dajjun took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the newly formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="PITKC" />

Along with Padawan Karii and several other Jedi, Dajjun was tasked by the High Council to determine the allegiance of the [[Sheyasti Trade Syndicate]] in the war. [[Mission to Kailion|Dispatched]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kailion]] and accompanied by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[4-B4]], the Jedi discovered that the Syndicate was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] goods and supplies to the CIS. In the process of recovering their proof, the team found difficulty escaping the [[Kailion caves|caves]] of the world, as they were filled with predators. However, Dajjon's charges were well trained and were able to overcome each hurdle, escaping back to the Coruscant Temple with their information.<ref name="PITKC" />
